flashcards.a: Sources -> Azure Monitor Agent / OTel distro / diagnostic settings -> Data Collection Rules (KQL transformations at ingest) -> Log Analytics tables. Platform metrics free ~93 days separately.

Full KQL with multi-table joins at included query price; 31 days interactive retention included (90 with Sentinel/App Insights); interactive extendable up to 2 years; long-term retention to ~12 years via search jobs.

Basic: reduced ingest rate, fixed 30-day interactive window, single-table KQL + lookups, billed per GB scanned. Auxiliary: cheapest ingest, slowest queries, audit-grade streams. Both reach ~12 years LTR.
Filtering MORE than ~50% of incoming data out via DCR transformations triggers billed log-processing charges on the excess - thoughtful filtering beats blanket drops.

flashcards.q: What does adaptive sampling preserve vs discard?
flashcards.a: Metrics aggregate PRE-sample so dashboards stay exact; individual request traces thin out - including the rare slow/failed outliers you need for forensics. Trace-based log sampling keeps logs consistent with trace decisions.
Near-real-time streaming with NO ingestion-volume charge - the outage-time tool when sampling has thinned history.

flashcards.q: Why daily caps are dangerous cost controls?
flashcards.a: Ingestion silently stops when cap hits - error telemetry vanishes exactly during incidents. Alert on cap-near/throttling metrics; treat caps as emergency brakes only, control cost upstream via transforms/plans/sampling.

flashcards.q: Metric alerts vs log alerts tradeoff?
flashcards.a: Metric: near-real-time on metrics store, cheap, dynamic thresholds learning seasonality. Log: scheduled KQL, expensive at high frequency, powerful cross-resource semantics - reserve for minute-plus semantic conditions.
Page on fast burn (~2% budget/hour class), ticket on slow burn (~5%/week); planned migrations consuming budget should pre-declare SLO pause windows, not bypass measurement.
NO - budgets only trigger threshold/forecast notifications. Enforcement requires Azure Policy (deny/modify) or automation reacting to budget events.

Reservations/savings-plan purchases appear correctly only under AMORTIZED views spread across consumers; actual-cost views make commitment purchases look like spend spikes - pick amortized for all internal reporting.

flashcards.q: How to make chargeback tags stick?
flashcards.a: Azure Policy deny-on-missing-tags at creation + inherit-from-resource-group append patterns + compliance dashboards from Resource Graph queries; exemptions documented with expiry dates.
TimeGenerated range filter FIRST (partition pruning), project needed columns early (columnar store), summarize/filter before joins; hot aggregates via summary rules beat raw scans structurally.
Standard instrumentation path replacing proprietary SDKs: W3C trace context, auto-instrumentations, unified traces/metrics/logs into App* tables; legacy MMA agent retired August 2024.
